data.other_hard: A minimum number of enrolled hours per term is required to be eligible for federal and institutional aid
data.evidence_sentence: A student must be enrolled for a minimum amount of hours to be eligible for federal and institutional aid.
data.notes: Page is a general graduate financial aid overview, not a single scholarship; it names no specific scholarship amount, criteria or deadline. Merit/need-based assistance from Brock School of Business and School of Health Professions is offered but unspecified and discretionary. Certificate-only programs are included in other. Loans (Direct Unsubsidized, Grad PLUS) are not scholarships and are not funding_type. Hour chart referenced but not included in text.
